theme: Young investor / first-timer: starting early, small amounts, ₹500/month
headline: Start Your Investment Journey With Small Steps
body: Beginning with ₹500 monthly builds discipline. Time and consistency matter more than amount.
caption: Small investments today can grow significantly over decades due to the power of compounding. Starting early gives your money more time to work for you. Young investors have time as their biggest advantage. #StartSmall #InvestEarly #CompoundingPower #YoungInvestor #ConsistentInvesting
